name: full_dev
description: Complete development pipeline: plan → research → implement → review → secure → test → polish

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.instruction: Create a clear architecture plan and file layout for the user request.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.instruction: Survey the workspace and provide concrete implementation guidance based on the plan.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.instruction: Implement the full solution using write_file. Complete, production-ready code only.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.instruction: Review the implementation for correctness, edge cases and quality. Score 1-10.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.instruction: Security-audit the written code. List findings and required patches.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.instruction: Write and run tests for the solution. Create test files and execute them.

nodes.label: Polish
nodes.instruction: Produce the final polished, consistent solution. Fix any remaining issues.
